stem: A fixed mass of an ideal gas is at a temperature of 21 °C. The pressure of the gas is 2.3 × 10⁵ Pa and its volume is 3.5 × 10⁻³ m³.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the number *N* of molecules in the gas.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
The mass of one molecule of the gas is 40 u.

Determine the root-mean-square (r.m.s.) speed of the gas molecules.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The temperature of the gas is increased by 84 °C.

Calculate the value of the ratio

$new r.m.s. speed of molecules / original r.m.s. speed of molecules$.
